# OWASP ASVS 5.0

<!-- Generated by scripts/asvs_crosswalk.py from docs/security/asvs-5.0-scope.csv, docs/security/asvs-status.csv
     and the tests' asvs marks. Edit those, not this page. -->

OpenClear measured against the [OWASP Application Security Verification Standard 5.0](https://owasp.org/www-project-application-security-verification-standard/), at Level 2, and Level 3 in V6–V11 and V16 ([ADR 0001](../adr/0001-asvs-level-2-with-level-3-for-identity-and-money.md)). The assessment was OpenClear's own; an independent penetration test is planned. It isn't legal advice ([Compliance](README.md)).

**Evidence** names the code or document that meets the requirement, and the tests that prove it (each test is marked with the requirement it proves, so this page can't name a test that doesn't exist). **Service provider's (CUEC)** means it depends on whoever runs the installation ([CUECs](cuecs.md)).

283 requirements in scope (62 more are above the target level or don't apply to OpenClear at all, such as WebRTC):

| Status | Requirements |
|---|---|
| Met | 214 |
| Partly | 8 |
| Not met | 5 |
| Service provider's (CUEC) | 15 |
| Not applicable | 41 |

Requirements not fully met are planned for 1.24 and 1.25, or recorded with their reason ([OWASP_PLAN.md](../../OWASP_PLAN.md)).
